verses.strongsText: Thou[G4771] therefore[G3767] which[G3588] teachest[G1321] another[G2087], teachest thou[G1321] not[G3756] thyself[G4572]? thou[G4771] that preachest[G2784] a man should[G2813] not[G3361] steal[G2813], dost thou[G4771] steal[G2813]?

verses.text: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?
verses.strongsText: Thou[G4771] that sayest[G3004] a man should[G3431] not[G3361] commit adultery[G3431], dost thou[G4771] commit adultery[G3431]? thou[G4771] that abhorrest[G948] idols[G1497], dost thou[G4771] commit sacrilege[G2416]?

verses.text: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?
verses.strongsText: Thou[G3739] that makest thy[G4675] boast[G2744] of[G1722] the law[G3551], through[G1223] breaking[G3847] the law[G3551] dishonourest thou[G818] God[G2316]?

verses.text: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] the name[G3686] of God[G2316] is blasphemed[G987] among[G1722] the Gentiles[G1484] through[G1223] you[G5209], as[G2531] it is written[G1125].

verses.text: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] circumcision[G4061] verily[G3303] profiteth[G5623], if[G1437] thou[G4771] keep[G4238] the law[G3551]: but[G1161] if[G1437] thou[G4771] be[G5600] a breaker[G3848] of the law[G3551], thy[G4675] circumcision[G4061] is made[G1096] uncircumcision[G203].

verses.text: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?
verses.strongsText: Therefore[G3767] if[G1437] the uncircumcision[G203] keep[G5442] the righteousness[G1345] of the law[G3551], shall[G3049] not[G3780] his[G846] uncircumcision[G203] be counted[G3049] for[G1519] circumcision[G4061]?

verses.text: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] shall not[G2919] uncircumcision[G203] which is by[G1537] nature[G5449], if it fulfil[G5055] the law[G3551], judge[G2919] thee[G4571], who by[G1223] the letter[G1121] and[G2532] circumcision[G4061] dost transgress[G3848] the law[G3551]?

verses.text: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither *is that* circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] he is[G2076] not[G3756] a Jew[G2453], which is one outwardly[G1722] [G5318]; neither[G3761] is that circumcision[G4061], which is outward[G1722] [G5318] in[G1722] the flesh[G4561]:

verses.text: But he *is* a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision *is that* of the heart, in the spirit, *and* not in the letter; whose praise *is* not of men, but of God.
verses.strongsText: But[G235] he is a Jew[G2453], which is one inwardly[G1722] [G2927]; and[G2532] circumcision[G4061] is that of the heart[G2588], in[G1722] the spirit[G4151], and not[G3756] in the letter[G1121]; whose[G3739] praise[G1868] is not[G3756] of[G1537] men[G444], but[G235] of[G1537] God[G2316].

verses.text: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit *is there* of circumcision?
verses.strongsText: What[G5101] advantage[G4053] then[G3767] hath the Jew[G2453]? or[G2228] what[G5101] profit[G5622] is there of circumcision[G4061]?

verses.text: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.
verses.strongsText: Much[G4183] every[G2596] [G3956] way[G5158]: chiefly[G4412], because[G3303] [G1063] that[G3754] unto them were committed[G4100] the oracles[G3051] of God[G2316].

verses.text: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] what[G5101] if[G1487] some[G5100] did not believe[G569]?[G3361] shall[G2673] their[G846] unbelief[G570] make[G2673] the faith[G4102] of God[G2316] without effect[G2673]?

verses.text: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.
verses.strongsText: God forbid[G3361] [G1096]: yea[G1161], let[G1096] God[G2316] be[G1096] true[G227], but[G1161] every[G3956] man[G444] a liar[G5583]; as[G2531] it is written[G1125], That[G3704] thou[G4771] mightest[G302] be justified[G1344] in[G1722] thy[G4675] sayings[G3056], and[G2532] mightest overcome[G3528] when[G1722] thou[G4571] art judged[G2919].

verses.text: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? *Is* God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] if[G1487] our[G2257] unrighteousness[G93] commend[G4921] the righteousness[G1343] of God[G2316], what[G5101] shall we say[G2046]?[G3361] Is God[G2316] unrighteous[G94] who taketh[G2018] vengeance[G3709]? (I speak[G3004] as[G2596] a man[G444])

verses.text: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?
verses.strongsText: God forbid[G3361] [G1096]: for then[G1893] how[G4459] shall[G2919] God[G2316] judge[G2919] the world[G2889]?

verses.text: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] if[G1487] the truth[G225] of God[G2316] hath more abounded[G4052] through[G1722] my[G1699] lie[G5582] unto[G1519] his[G846] glory[G1391]; why[G5101] yet[G2089] am[G2919] I also[G2504] judged[G2919] as[G5613] a sinner[G268]?

verses.text: And not *rather*, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] not[G3361] rather, (as[G2531] we be slanderously reported[G987], and[G2532] as[G2531] some[G5100] affirm[G5346] that we[G2248] say[G3004],)[G3754] Let us do[G4160] evil[G2556], that[G2443] good[G18] may come[G2064]? whose[G3739] damnation[G2917] is[G2076] just[G1738].

verses.text: What then? are we better *than they*? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;
verses.strongsText: What[G5101] then[G3767]? are we better[G4284] than they? No[G3756], in no wise[G3843]: for[G1063] we have before proved[G4256] both[G5037] Jews[G2453] and[G2532] Gentiles[G1672], that they are[G1511] all[G3956] under[G5259] sin[G266];

verses.text: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:
verses.strongsText: As[G2531] it is written[G1125],[G3754] There is[G2076] none[G3756] righteous[G1342], no, not[G3761] one[G1520]:

verses.text: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.
verses.strongsText: There is[G2076] none[G3756] that understandeth[G4920], there is[G2076] none[G3756] that seeketh after[G1567] God[G2316].

verses.text: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.strongsText: They are[G1578] all[G3956] gone out of the way[G1578], they are[G889] together[G260] become unprofitable[G889]; there is[G2076] none[G3756] that doeth[G4160] good[G5544], no, not[G3756] one[G2076] [G2193] [G1520].

verses.text: Their throat *is* an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps *is* under their lips:
verses.strongsText: Their[G846] throat[G2995] is an open[G455] sepulchre[G5028]; with their[G846] tongues[G1100] they have used deceit[G1387]; the poison[G2447] of asps[G785] is under[G5259] their[G846] lips[G5491]:

verses.text: Whose mouth *is* full of cursing and bitterness:
verses.strongsText: Whose[G3739] mouth[G4750] is full[G1073] of cursing[G685] and[G2532] bitterness[G4088]:

verses.text: Their feet *are* swift to shed blood:
verses.strongsText: Their[G846] feet[G4228] are swift[G3691] to shed[G1632] blood[G129]:

verses.text: Destruction and misery *are* in their ways:
verses.strongsText: Destruction[G4938] and[G2532] misery[G5004] are in[G1722] their[G846] ways[G3598]:

verses.text: And the way of peace have they not known:
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] the way[G3598] of peace[G1515] have[G1097] they not[G3756] known[G1097]:

verses.text: There is no fear of God before their eyes.
verses.strongsText: There is[G2076] no[G3756] fear[G5401] of God[G2316] before[G561] their[G846] eyes[G3788].

verses.text: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.
verses.strongsText: Now[G1161] we know[G1492] that[G3754] what things soever[G3745] the law[G3551] saith[G3004], it saith[G2980] to them who are under[G1722] the law[G3551]: that[G2443] every[G3956] mouth[G4750] may be stopped[G5420], and[G2532] all[G3956] the world[G2889] may become[G1096] guilty[G5267] before God[G2316].

verses.text: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law *is* the knowledge of sin.
verses.strongsText: Therefore[G1360] by[G1537] the deeds[G2041] of the law[G3551] there shall[G1344] no[G3956] [G3756] flesh[G4561] be justified[G1344] in his[G846] sight[G1799]: for[G1063] by[G1223] the law[G3551] is the knowledge[G1922] of sin[G266].

verses.text: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] now[G3570] the righteousness[G1343] of God[G2316] without[G5565] the law[G3551] is manifested[G5319], being witnessed[G3140] by[G5259] the law[G3551] and[G2532] the prophets[G4396];

verses.text: Even the righteousness of God *which is* by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:
verses.strongsText: Even[G1161] the righteousness[G1343] of God[G2316] which is by[G1223] faith[G4102] of Jesus[G2424] Christ[G5547] unto[G1519] all[G3956] and[G2532] upon[G1909] all[G3956] them that believe[G4100]: for[G1063] there is[G2076] no[G3756] difference[G1293]:

verses.text: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] all[G3956] have sinned[G264], and[G2532] come short[G5302] of the glory[G1391] of God[G2316];

verses.text: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
verses.strongsText: Being justified[G1344] freely[G1432] by his[G846] grace[G5485] through[G1223] the redemption[G629] that is in[G1722] Christ[G5547] Jesus[G2424]:

verses.text: Whom God hath set forth *to be* a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
verses.strongsText: Whom[G3739] God[G2316] hath set forth[G4388] to be a propitiation[G2435] through[G1223] faith[G4102] in[G1722] his[G846] blood[G129], to[G1519] declare[G1732] his[G846] righteousness[G1343] for[G1223] the remission[G3929] of sins[G265] that are past[G4266], through[G1722] the forbearance[G463] of God[G2316];

verses.text: To declare, *I say*, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.
verses.strongsText: To[G4314] declare[G1732], I say, at[G1722] this[G3568] time[G2540] his[G846] righteousness[G1343]: that[G1519] he might be[G1511] just[G1342], and[G2532] the justifier[G1344] of him[G846] which believeth[G4102] in[G1537] Jesus[G2424].

verses.text: Where *is* boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.
verses.strongsText: Where[G4226] is boasting[G2746] then[G3767]? It is excluded[G1576]. By[G1223] what[G4169] law[G3551]? of works[G2041]? Nay[G3780]: but[G235] by[G1223] the law[G3551] of faith[G4102].

verses.text: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.
verses.strongsText: Therefore[G3767] we conclude[G3049] that a man[G444] is justified[G1344] by faith[G4102] without[G5565] the deeds[G2041] of the law[G3551].

verses.text: *Is he* the God of the Jews only? *is he* not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:
verses.strongsText: Is he [G2228] the God[G2316] of the Jews[G2453] only[G3440]? is he not[G3780] also[G1161] [G2532] of the Gentiles[G1484]? Yes[G3483], of the Gentiles[G1484] also[G2532]:

verses.text: Seeing *it is* one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.
verses.strongsText: Seeing[G1897] it is one[G1520] God[G2316], which[G3739] shall justify[G1344] the circumcision[G4061] by[G1537] faith[G4102], and[G2532] uncircumcision[G203] through[G1223] faith[G4102].

verses.text: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.
verses.strongsText: Do we[G2673] then[G3767] make void[G2673] the law[G3551] through[G1223] faith[G4102]? God forbid[G3361] [G1096]: yea[G235], we establish[G2476] the law[G3551].

verses.text: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?
verses.strongsText: What[G5101] shall we say[G2046] then[G3767] that Abraham[G11] our[G2257] father[G3962], as pertaining[G2596] to the flesh[G4561], hath found[G2147]?

verses.text: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath *whereof* to glory; but not before God.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] if[G1487] Abraham[G11] were justified[G1344] by[G1537] works[G2041], he hath[G2192] whereof to glory[G2745]; but[G235] not[G3756] before[G4314] God[G2316].

verses.text: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] what[G5101] saith[G3004] the scripture[G1124]?[G1161] Abraham[G11] believed[G4100] God[G2316], and[G2532] it was counted[G3049] unto him[G846] for[G1519] righteousness[G1343].

verses.text: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.
verses.strongsText: Now[G1161] to him that worketh[G2038] is[G3049] the reward[G3408] not[G3756] reckoned[G3049] of[G2596] grace[G5485], but[G235] of[G2596] debt[G3783].

verses.text: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] to him that worketh[G2038] not[G3361], but[G1161] believeth[G4100] on[G1909] him that justifieth[G1344] the ungodly[G765], his[G846] faith[G4102] is counted[G3049] for[G1519] righteousness[G1343].

verses.text: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,
verses.strongsText: Even as[G2509] David[G1138] also[G2532] describeth[G3004] the blessedness[G3108] of the man[G444], unto whom[G3739] God[G2316] imputeth[G3049] righteousness[G1343] without[G5565] works[G2041],

verses.text: *Saying*, Blessed *are* they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
verses.strongsText: Saying, Blessed[G3107] are they whose[G3739] iniquities[G458] are forgiven[G863], and[G2532] whose[G3739] sins[G266] are covered[G1943].

verses.text: Blessed *is* the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.
verses.strongsText: Blessed[G3107] is the man[G435] to whom[G3739] the Lord[G2962] will[G3049] not[G3364] impute[G3049] sin[G266].

verses.text: *Cometh* this blessedness then upon the circumcision *only*, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
verses.strongsText: Cometh this[G3778] blessedness[G3108] then[G3767] upon[G1909] the circumcision[G4061] only, or[G2228] upon[G1909] the uncircumcision[G203] also[G2532]? for[G1063] we say[G3004] that[G3754] faith[G4102] was reckoned[G3049] to Abraham[G11] for[G1519] righteousness[G1343].

verses.text: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
verses.strongsText: How[G4459] was it[G3049] then[G3767] reckoned[G3049]? when he was[G5607] in[G1722] circumcision[G4061], or[G2228] in[G1722] uncircumcision[G203]? Not[G3756] in[G1722] circumcision[G4061], but[G235] in[G1722] uncircumcision[G203].

verses.text: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which *he had yet* being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] he received[G2983] the sign[G4592] of circumcision[G4061], a seal[G4973] of the righteousness[G1343] of the faith[G4102] which[G3588] he had yet being[G1722] uncircumcised[G203]: that[G1519] he[G846] might be[G1511] the father[G3962] of all[G3956] them that believe[G4100], though[G1223] they be not circumcised[G203]; that[G1519] righteousness[G1343] might be imputed[G3049] unto them[G846] also[G2532]:

verses.text: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which *he had* being *yet* uncircumcised.
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] the father[G3962] of circumcision[G4061] to them who are not[G3756] of[G1537] the circumcision[G4061] only[G3440], but[G235] who also[G2532] walk[G4748] in the steps[G2487] of that faith[G4102] of our[G2257] father[G3962] Abraham[G11], which he had being[G1722] yet uncircumcised[G203].

verses.text: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, *was* not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] the promise[G1860], that he should be[G1511] the[G846] heir[G2818] of the world[G2889], was not[G3756] to Abraham[G11], or[G2228] to his[G846] seed[G4690], through[G1223] the law[G3551], but[G235] through[G1223] the righteousness[G1343] of faith[G4102].

verses.text: For if they which are of the law *be* heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] if[G1487] they which are of[G1537] the law[G3551] be heirs[G2818], faith[G4102] is made void[G2758], and[G2532] the promise[G1860] made of none effect[G2673]:

verses.text: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, *there is* no transgression.
verses.strongsText: Because[G1063] the law[G3551] worketh[G2716] wrath[G3709]: for[G1063] where[G3757] no[G3756] law[G3551] is[G2076], there is no[G3761] transgression[G3847].

verses.text: Therefore *it is* of faith, that *it might be* by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
verses.strongsText: Therefore[G1223] [G5124] it is of[G1537] faith[G4102], that[G2443] it might be by[G2596] grace[G5485]; to the end[G1519] the promise[G1860] might be[G1511] sure[G949] to all[G3956] the seed[G4690]; not[G3756] to that only[G3440] which is of[G1537] the law[G3551], but[G235] to that also[G2532] which is of[G1537] the faith[G4102] of Abraham[G11]; who[G3739] is[G2076] the father[G3962] of us[G2257] all[G3956],

verses.text: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, *even* God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.
verses.strongsText: (As[G2531] it is written[G1125],[G3754] I have made[G5087] thee[G4571] a father[G3962] of many[G4183] nations[G1484],) before[G2713] him whom[G3739] he believed[G4100], even God[G2316], who quickeneth[G2227] the dead[G3498], and[G2532] calleth[G2564] those things which be[G5607] not[G3361] as though[G5613] they were[G5607].

verses.text: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations, according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.
verses.strongsText: Who[G3739] against[G3844] hope[G1680] believed[G4100] in[G1909] hope[G1680], that[G1519] he[G846] might become[G1096] the father[G3962] of many[G4183] nations[G1484]; according[G2596] to that which was spoken[G2046], So[G3779] shall[G2071] thy[G4675] seed[G4690] be[G2071].

verses.text: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sara's womb:
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] being not[G3361] weak[G770] in faith[G4102], he considered[G2657] not[G3756] his own[G1438] body[G4983] now[G2235] dead[G3499], when he was[G5225] about[G4225] an hundred years old[G1541], neither yet[G2532] the deadness[G3500] of Sarah's[G4564] womb[G3388]:

verses.text: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
verses.strongsText: [G1161] He staggered[G1252] not[G3756] at[G1519] the promise[G1860] of God[G2316] through unbelief[G570]; but[G235] was strong[G1743] in faith[G4102], giving[G1325] glory[G1391] to God[G2316];

verses.text: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] being fully persuaded[G4135] that[G3754], what[G3739] he had promised[G1861], he was[G2076] able[G1415] also[G2532] to perform[G4160].

verses.text: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] therefore[G1352] it was imputed[G3049] to him[G846] for[G1519] righteousness[G1343].

verses.text: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;
verses.strongsText: Now[G1161] it was[G1125] not[G3756] written[G1125] for his sake[G1223] [G846] alone[G3440], that[G3754] it was imputed[G3049] to him[G846];

verses.text: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;
verses.strongsText: But[G235] for[G1223] us[G2248] also[G2532], to whom[G3739] it shall be[G3195] imputed[G3049], if we believe[G4100] on[G1909] him that raised up[G1453] Jesus[G2424] our[G2257] Lord[G2962] from[G1537] the dead[G3498];

verses.text: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.
verses.strongsText: Who[G3739] was delivered[G3860] for[G1223] our[G2257] offences[G3900], and[G2532] was raised again[G1453] for[G1223] our[G2257] justification[G1347].

verses.text: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.strongsText: Therefore[G3767] being justified[G1344] by[G1537] faith[G4102], we have[G2192] peace[G1515] with[G4314] God[G2316] through[G1223] our[G2257] Lord[G2962] Jesus[G2424] Christ[G5547]:

verses.text: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
verses.strongsText: By[G1223] whom[G3739] also[G2532] we have[G2192] access[G4318] by faith[G4102] into[G1519] this[G5026] grace[G5485] wherein[G1722] [G3739] we stand[G2476], and[G2532] rejoice[G2744] in[G1909] hope[G1680] of the glory[G1391] of God[G2316].

verses.text: And not only *so*, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] not[G3756] only[G3440] so, but[G235] we glory[G2744] in[G1722] tribulations[G2347] also[G2532]: knowing[G1492] that[G3754] tribulation[G2347] worketh[G2716] patience[G5281];

verses.text: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] patience[G5281], experience[G1382]; and[G1161] experience[G1382], hope[G1680]:

verses.text: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] hope[G1680] maketh[G2617] not[G3756] ashamed[G2617]; because[G3754] the love[G26] of God[G2316] is shed abroad[G1632] in[G1722] our[G2257] hearts[G2588] by[G1223] the Holy[G40] Ghost[G4151] which[G3588] is given[G1325] unto us[G2254].

verses.text: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] when we[G2257] were[G5607] yet[G2089] without strength[G772], in due[G2596] time[G2540] Christ[G5547] died[G599] for[G5228] the ungodly[G765].

verses.text: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] scarcely[G3433] for[G5228] a righteous man[G1342] will[G599] one[G5100] die[G599]: yet[G1063] peradventure[G5029] for[G5228] a good man[G18] some[G5100] would[G5111] even[G2532] dare[G5111] to die[G599].

verses.text: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] God[G2316] commendeth[G4921] his[G1438] love[G26] toward[G1519] us[G2248], in that[G3754], while we[G2257] were[G5607] yet[G2089] sinners[G268], Christ[G5547] died[G599] for[G5228] us[G2257].

verses.text: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.
verses.strongsText: Much[G4183] more[G3123] then[G3767], being[G1344] now[G3568] justified[G1344] by[G1722] his[G846] blood[G129], we shall be saved[G4982] from[G575] wrath[G3709] through[G1223] him[G846].

verses.text: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] if[G1487], when we were[G5607] enemies[G2190], we were reconciled[G2644] to God[G2316] by[G1223] the death[G2288] of his[G846] Son[G5207], much[G4183] more[G3123], being reconciled[G2644], we shall be saved[G4982] by[G1722] his[G846] life[G2222].

verses.text: And not only *so*, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] not[G3756] only[G3440] so, but[G235] we also[G2532] joy[G2744] in[G1722] God[G2316] through[G1223] our[G2257] Lord[G2962] Jesus[G2424] Christ[G5547], by[G1223] whom[G3739] we have[G2983] now[G3568] received[G2983] the atonement[G2643].

verses.text: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:
verses.strongsText: Wherefore[G1223] [G5124], as[G5618] by[G1223] one[G1520] man[G444] sin[G266] entered[G1525] into[G1519] the world[G2889], and[G2532] death[G2288] by[G1223] sin[G266]; and[G2532] so[G3779] death[G2288] passed[G1330] upon[G1519] all[G3956] men[G444], for[G1909] that[G3739] all[G3956] have sinned[G264]:

verses.text: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
verses.strongsText: (For[G1063] until[G891] the law[G3551] sin[G266] was[G2258] in[G1722] the world[G2889]: but[G1161] sin[G266] is[G1677] not[G3756] imputed[G1677] when there is[G5607] no[G3361] law[G3551].

verses.text: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
verses.strongsText: Nevertheless[G235] death[G2288] reigned[G936] from[G575] Adam[G76] to[G3360] Moses[G3475], even[G2532] over[G1909] them that had[G264] not[G3361] sinned[G264] after[G1909] the similitude[G3667] of Adam's[G76] transgression[G3847], who[G3739] is[G2076] the figure[G5179] of him that was to come[G3195].

verses.text: But not as the offence, so also *is* the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, *which is* by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.
verses.strongsText: But[G235] not[G3756] as[G5613] the offence[G3900], so[G3779] also[G2532] is the free gift[G5486]. For[G1063] if[G1487] through the offence[G3900] of one[G1520] many[G4183] be dead[G599], much[G4183] more[G3123] the grace[G5485] of God[G2316], and[G2532] the gift[G1431] by[G1722] grace[G5485], which is[G3588] by one[G1520] man[G444], Jesus[G2424] Christ[G5547], hath abounded[G4052] unto[G1519] many[G4183].

verses.text: And not as *it was* by one that sinned, *so is* the gift: for the judgment *was* by one to condemnation, but the free gift *is* of many offences unto justification.
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] not[G3756] as[G5613] it was by[G1223] one[G1520] that sinned[G264], so is the gift[G1434]: for[G1063] [G3303] the judgment[G2917] was by[G1537] one[G1520] to[G1519] condemnation[G2631], but[G1161] the free gift[G5486] is of[G1537] many[G4183] offences[G3900] unto[G1519] justification[G1345].

verses.text: For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] if[G1487] by one man's[G1520] offence[G3900] death[G2288] reigned[G936] by[G1223] one[G1520]; much[G4183] more[G3123] they which receive[G2983] abundance[G4050] of grace[G5485] and[G2532] of the gift[G1431] of righteousness[G1343] shall reign[G936] in[G1722] life[G2222] by[G1223] one[G1520], Jesus[G2424] Christ[G5547].)

verses.text: Therefore as by the offence of one *judgment came* upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one *the free gift came* upon all men unto justification of life.
verses.strongsText: Therefore[G686] [G3767] as[G5613] by[G1223] the offence[G3900] of one[G1520] judgment came upon[G1519] all[G3956] men[G444] to[G1519] condemnation[G2631]; even[G2532] so[G3779] by[G1223] the righteousness[G1345] of one[G1520] the free gift came upon[G1519] all[G3956] men[G444] unto[G1519] justification[G1347] of life[G2222].

verses.text: For as by one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] as[G5618] by[G1223] one[G1520] man's[G444] disobedience[G3876] many[G4183] were made[G2525] sinners[G268], so[G3779] [G2532] by[G1223] the obedience[G5218] of one[G1520] shall[G2525] many[G4183] be made[G2525] righteous[G1342].

verses.text: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
verses.strongsText: Moreover[G1161] the law[G3551] entered[G3922], that[G2443] the offence[G3900] might abound[G4121]. But[G1161] where[G3757] sin[G266] abounded[G4121], grace[G5485] did much more abound[G5248]:

verses.text: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.strongsText: That[G2443] as[G5618] sin[G266] hath reigned[G936] unto[G1722] death[G2288], even[G2532] so[G3779] might[G936] grace[G5485] reign[G936] through[G1223] righteousness[G1343] unto[G1519] eternal[G166] life[G2222] by[G1223] Jesus[G2424] Christ[G5547] our[G2257] Lord[G2962].

verses.text: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
verses.strongsText: What[G5101] shall we say[G2046] then[G3767]? Shall we continue[G1961] in sin[G266], that[G2443] grace[G5485] may abound[G4121]?

verses.text: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?
verses.strongsText: God forbid[G3361] [G1096]. How[G4459] shall we, that[G3748] are dead[G599] to sin[G266], live[G2198] any longer[G2089] therein[G1722] [G846]?

verses.text: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?
verses.strongsText: [G2228] Know ye[G5210] not[G50], that so[G3754] many of us[G3745] as were baptized[G907] into[G1519] Jesus[G2424] Christ[G5547] were baptized[G907] into[G1519] his[G846] death[G2288]?

verses.text: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
verses.strongsText: Therefore[G3767] we are buried with[G4916] him[G846] by[G1223] baptism[G908] into[G1519] death[G2288]: that[G2443] like as[G5618] Christ[G5547] was raised up[G1453] from[G1537] the dead[G3498] by[G1223] the glory[G1391] of the Father[G3962], even so[G3779] we[G2249] also[G2532] should walk[G4043] in[G1722] newness[G2538] of life[G2222].

verses.text: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also *in the likeness* of *his* resurrection:
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] if[G1487] we have been[G1096] planted together[G4854] in the likeness[G3667] of his[G846] death[G2288], we shall be[G2071] also[G235] [G2532] in the likeness of his resurrection[G386]:

verses.text: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with *him*, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.
verses.strongsText: Knowing[G1097] this[G5124], that[G3754] our[G2257] old[G3820] man[G444] is crucified with[G4957] him, that[G2443] the body[G4983] of sin[G266] might be destroyed[G2673], that henceforth[G3371] we[G2248] should[G1398] not[G3371] serve[G1398] sin[G266].

verses.text: For he that is dead is freed from sin.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] he that is dead[G599] is freed[G1344] from[G575] sin[G266].

verses.text: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:
verses.strongsText: Now[G1161] if[G1487] we be dead[G599] with[G4862] Christ[G5547], we believe[G4100] that[G3754] we shall[G4800] also[G2532] live[G4800] with him[G846]:

verses.text: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.
verses.strongsText: Knowing[G1492] that[G3754] Christ[G5547] being raised[G1453] from[G1537] the dead[G3498] dieth[G599] no more[G3765]; death[G2288] hath[G2961] no more[G3765] dominion over[G2961] him[G846].

verses.text: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.
verses.strongsText: For[G3739] [G1063] in that he died[G599], he died[G599] unto sin[G266] once[G2178]: but[G1161] in that[G3739] he liveth[G2198], he liveth[G2198] unto God[G2316].

verses.text: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.strongsText: Likewise[G3779] reckon[G3049] ye[G5210] also[G2532] yourselves[G1438] to be[G1511] dead[G3498] indeed[G3303] unto sin[G266], but[G1161] alive[G2198] unto God[G2316] through[G1722] Jesus[G2424] Christ[G5547] our[G2257] Lord[G2962].

verses.text: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.
verses.strongsText: Let[G936] not[G3361] sin[G266] therefore[G3767] reign[G936] in[G1722] your[G5216] mortal[G2349] body[G4983], that[G1519] ye[G5210] should obey[G5219] it[G846] in[G1722] the lusts[G1939] thereof[G846].

verses.text: Neither yield ye your members *as* instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members *as* instruments of righteousness unto God.
verses.strongsText: Neither[G3366] yield ye[G3936] your[G5216] members[G3196] as instruments[G3696] of unrighteousness[G93] unto sin[G266]: but[G235] yield[G3936] yourselves[G1438] unto God[G2316], as[G5613] those that are alive[G2198] from[G1537] the dead[G3498], and[G2532] your[G5216] members[G3196] as instruments[G3696] of righteousness[G1343] unto God[G2316].

verses.text: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] sin[G266] shall[G2961] not[G3756] have dominion over[G2961] you[G5216]: for[G1063] ye[G5210] are[G2075] not[G3756] under[G5259] the law[G3551], but[G235] under[G5259] grace[G5485].

verses.text: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.
verses.strongsText: What[G5101] then[G3767]? shall we sin[G264], because[G3754] we are[G2070] not[G3756] under[G5259] the law[G3551], but[G235] under[G5259] grace[G5485]? God forbid[G3361] [G1096].

verses.text: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?
verses.strongsText: Know ye[G1492] not[G3756], that[G3754] to whom[G3739] ye[G5210] yield[G3936] yourselves[G1438] servants[G1401] to[G1519] obey[G5218], his servants[G1401] ye[G5210] are[G2075] to whom[G3739] ye[G5210] obey[G5219]; whether[G2273] of sin[G266] unto[G1519] death[G2288], or[G2228] of obedience[G5218] unto[G1519] righteousness[G1343]?

verses.text: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] God[G2316] be thanked[G5485], that[G3754] ye[G5210] were[G2258] the servants[G1401] of sin[G266], but[G1161] ye[G5210] have obeyed[G5219] from[G1537] the heart[G2588] that form[G5179] of doctrine[G1322] which[G1519] [G3739] was delivered you[G3860].

verses.text: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.
verses.strongsText: Being[G1659] then[G1161] made free[G1659] from[G575] sin[G266], ye[G5210] became the servants[G1402] of righteousness[G1343].

verses.text: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.
verses.strongsText: I speak[G3004] after the manner of men[G442] because[G1223] of the infirmity[G769] of your[G5216] flesh[G4561]: for[G1063] as[G5618] ye[G5210] have yielded[G3936] your[G5216] members[G3196] servants[G1401] to uncleanness[G167] and[G2532] to iniquity[G458] unto[G1519] iniquity[G458]; even so[G3779] now[G3568] yield[G3936] your[G5216] members[G3196] servants[G1401] to righteousness[G1343] unto[G1519] holiness[G38].

verses.text: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] when[G3753] ye[G5210] were[G2258] the servants[G1401] of sin[G266], ye[G5210] were[G2258] free[G1658] from righteousness[G1343].

verses.text: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things *is* death.
verses.strongsText: What[G5101] [G3767] fruit[G2590] had ye[G2192] then[G5119] in[G1909] those things whereof[G3739] ye[G5210] are[G1870] now[G3568] ashamed[G1870]? for[G1063] the end[G5056] of those things[G1565] is death[G2288].

verses.text: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] now[G3570] being made free[G1659] from[G575] sin[G266], and[G1161] become servants[G1402] to God[G2316], ye[G5210] have[G2192] your[G5216] fruit[G2590] unto[G1519] holiness[G38], and[G1161] the end[G5056] everlasting[G166] life[G2222].

verses.text: For the wages of sin *is* death; but the gift of God *is* eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] the wages[G3800] of sin[G266] is death[G2288]; but[G1161] the gift[G5486] of God[G2316] is eternal[G166] life[G2222] through[G1722] Jesus[G2424] Christ[G5547] our[G2257] Lord[G2962].

verses.text: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?
verses.strongsText: [G2228] Know ye[G5210] not[G50], brethren[G80], (for[G1063] I speak[G2980] to them that know[G1097] the law[G3551],) how that[G3754] the law[G3551] hath dominion over[G2961] a man[G444] as long as[G1909] [G3745] [G5550] he liveth[G2198]?

verses.text: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to *her* husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of *her* husband.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] the woman[G1135] which hath an husband[G5220] is bound[G1210] by the law[G3551] to her husband[G435] so long as he liveth[G2198]; but[G1161] if[G1437] the husband[G435] be dead[G599], she is loosed[G2673] from[G575] the law[G3551] of her husband[G435].

verses.text: So then if, while *her* husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.
verses.strongsText: So then[G686] [G3767] if[G1437], while her husband[G435] liveth[G2198], she be married[G1096] to another[G2087] man[G435], she shall be called[G5537] an adulteress[G3428]: but[G1161] if[G1437] her husband[G435] be dead[G599], she is[G2076] free[G1658] from[G575] that law[G3551]; so that she[G846] is[G1511] no[G3361] adulteress[G3428], though she be married[G1096] to another[G2087] man[G435].

verses.text: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, *even* to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.
verses.strongsText: Wherefore[G5620], my[G3450] brethren[G80], ye[G5210] also[G2532] are become dead[G2289] to the law[G3551] by[G1223] the body[G4983] of Christ[G5547]; that[G1519] ye[G5209] should be married[G1096] to another[G2087], even to him who is raised[G1453] from[G1537] the dead[G3498], that[G2443] we should bring forth fruit[G2592] unto God[G2316].

verses.text: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] when[G3753] we were[G2258] in[G1722] the flesh[G4561], the motions[G3804] of sins[G266], which[G3588] were by[G1223] the law[G3551], did work[G1754] in[G1722] our[G2257] members[G3196] to bring[G1519] forth fruit[G2592] unto death[G2288].

verses.text: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not *in* the oldness of the letter.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] now[G3570] we are delivered[G2673] from[G575] the law[G3551], that being dead[G599] [G599] wherein[G1722] [G3739] we were held[G2722]; that[G5620] we[G2248] should serve[G1398] in[G1722] newness[G2538] of spirit[G4151], and[G2532] not[G3756] in the oldness[G3821] of the letter[G1121].

verses.text: What shall we say then? *Is* the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.
verses.strongsText: What[G5101] shall we say[G2046] then[G3767]? Is the law[G3551] sin[G266]? God forbid[G3361] [G1096]. Nay[G235], I had[G1097] not[G3756] known[G1097] sin[G266], but[G1508] by[G1223] the law[G3551]: for[G1063] [G5037] I had[G1492] not[G3756] known[G1492] lust[G1939], except[G1508] the law[G3551] had said[G3004], Thou[G4771] shalt[G1937] not[G3756] covet[G1937].

verses.text: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin *was* dead.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] sin[G266], taking[G2983] occasion[G874] by[G1223] the commandment[G1785], wrought[G2716] in[G1722] me[G1698] all manner of[G3956] concupiscence[G1939]. For[G1063] without[G5565] the law[G3551] sin[G266] was dead[G3498].

verses.text: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
verses.strongsText: For[G1161] I[G1473] was alive[G2198] without[G5565] the law[G3551] once[G4218]: but[G1161] when the commandment[G1785] came[G2064], sin[G266] revived[G326], and[G1161] I[G1473] died[G599].

verses.text: And the commandment, which *was ordained* to life, I found *to be* unto death.
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] the commandment[G1785], which[G3588] was ordained to[G1519] life[G2222], I[G3427] found[G2147] [G3778] to be unto[G1519] death[G2288].

verses.text: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew *me*.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] sin[G266], taking[G2983] occasion[G874] by[G1223] the commandment[G1785], deceived[G1818] me[G3165], and[G2532] by[G1223] it[G846] slew[G615] me.

verses.text: Wherefore the law *is* holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.
verses.strongsText: Wherefore[G5620] [G3303] the law[G3551] is holy[G40], and[G2532] the commandment[G1785] holy[G40], and[G2532] just[G1342], and[G2532] good[G18].

verses.text: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.
verses.strongsText: Was then[G3767] that which is good[G18] made[G1096] death[G2288] unto me[G1698]? God forbid[G3361] [G1096]. But[G235] sin[G266], that[G2443] it might appear[G5316] sin[G266], working[G2716] death[G2288] in me[G3427] by[G1223] that which is good[G18]; that[G2443] sin[G266] by[G1223] the commandment[G1785] might become[G1096] exceeding[G2596] [G5236] sinful[G268].

verses.text: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] we know[G1492] that[G3754] the law[G3551] is[G2076] spiritual[G4152]: but[G1161] I[G1473] am[G1510] carnal[G4559], sold[G4097] under[G5259] sin[G266].

verses.text: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] that which[G3739] I do[G2716] I allow[G1097] not[G3756]: for[G1063] what[G3739] I would[G2309], that[G5124] do I[G4238] not[G3756]; but[G235] what[G3739] I hate[G3404], that[G5124] do I[G4160].

verses.text: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that *it is* good.
verses.strongsText: If[G1487] then[G1161] I do[G4160] that[G5124] which[G3739] I would[G2309] not[G3756], I consent[G4852] unto the law[G3551] that[G3754] it is good[G2570].

verses.text: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
verses.strongsText: Now[G3570] then[G1161] it is no more[G3765] I[G1473] that do[G2716] it[G846], but[G235] sin[G266] that dwelleth[G3611] in[G1722] me[G1698].

verses.text: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but *how* to perform that which is good I find not.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] I know[G1492] that[G3754] in[G1722] me[G1698] (that is[G5123], in[G1722] my[G3450] flesh[G4561],) dwelleth[G3611] no[G3756] good thing[G18]: for[G1063] to will[G2309] is present[G3873] with me[G3427]; but[G1161] how to perform[G2716] that which is good[G2570] I find[G2147] not[G3756].

verses.text: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] [G3739] the good[G18] that I would[G2309] I do[G4160] not[G3756]: but[G235] the evil[G2556] which[G3739] I would[G2309] not[G3756], that[G5124] I do[G4238].

verses.text: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
verses.strongsText: Now[G1161] if[G1487] [G3739] I do[G4160] that[G5124] I[G1473] would[G2309] not[G3756], it is no more[G2089] [G3765] I[G1473] that do[G2716] it[G846], but[G235] sin[G266] that dwelleth[G3611] in[G1722] me[G1698].

verses.text: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.
verses.strongsText: I find[G2147] then[G686] a law[G3551], that[G3754], when I[G1698] would[G2309] do[G4160] good[G2570], evil[G2556] is present[G3873] with me[G1698].

verses.text: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] I delight[G4913] in the law[G3551] of God[G2316] after[G2596] the inward[G2080] man[G444]:

verses.text: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] I see[G991] another[G2087] law[G3551] in[G1722] my[G3450] members[G3196], warring against[G497] the law[G3551] of my[G3450] mind[G3563], and[G2532] bringing[G163] me[G3165] into captivity[G163] to the law[G3551] of sin[G266] which[G3588] is[G5607] in[G1722] my[G3450] members[G3196].

verses.text: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
verses.strongsText: O wretched[G5005] man[G444] that I am[G1473]! who[G5101] shall deliver[G4506] me[G3165] from[G1537] the body[G4983] of this[G5127] death[G2288]?

verses.text: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.
verses.strongsText: I thank[G2168] God[G2316] through[G1223] Jesus[G2424] Christ[G5547] our[G2257] Lord[G2962]. So then[G686] [G3767] with the mind[G3563] I[G1473] myself[G846] serve[G3303] [G1398] the law[G3551] of God[G2316]; but[G1161] with the flesh[G4561] the law[G3551] of sin[G266].

verses.text: *There is* therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.strongsText: There is therefore[G686] now[G3568] no[G3762] condemnation[G2631] to them which are in[G1722] Christ[G5547] Jesus[G2424], who walk[G4043] not[G3361] after[G2596] the flesh[G4561], but[G235] after[G2596] the Spirit[G4151].

verses.text: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] the law[G3551] of the Spirit[G4151] of life[G2222] in[G1722] Christ[G5547] Jesus[G2424] hath made[G1659] me[G3165] free[G1659] from[G575] the law[G3551] of sin[G266] and[G2532] death[G2288].

verses.text: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] what the law[G3551] could not do[G102], in[G1722] that[G3739] it was weak[G770] through[G1223] the flesh[G4561], God[G2316] sending[G3992] his own[G1438] Son[G5207] in[G1722] the likeness[G3667] of sinful[G266] flesh[G4561], and[G2532] for[G4012] sin[G266], condemned[G2632] sin[G266] in[G1722] the flesh[G4561]:

verses.text: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.strongsText: That[G2443] the righteousness[G1345] of the law[G3551] might be fulfilled[G4137] in[G1722] us[G2254], who walk[G4043] not[G3361] after[G2596] the flesh[G4561], but[G235] after[G2596] the Spirit[G4151].

verses.text: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] they that are[G5607] after[G2596] the flesh[G4561] do mind[G5426] the things[G3588] of the flesh[G4561]; but[G1161] they that are after[G2596] the Spirit[G4151] the things[G3588] of the Spirit[G4151].

verses.text: For to be carnally minded *is* death; but to be spiritually minded *is* life and peace.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] to be[G5427] carnally[G4561] minded[G5427] is death[G2288]; but[G1161] to be[G5427] spiritually[G4151] minded[G5427] is life[G2222] and[G2532] peace[G1515].

verses.text: Because the carnal mind *is* enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.
verses.strongsText: Because[G1360] the carnal[G4561] mind[G5427] is enmity[G2189] against[G1519] God[G2316]: for[G1063] it is[G5293] not[G3756] subject[G5293] to the law[G3551] of God[G2316], neither[G3761] indeed[G1063] can be[G1410].

verses.text: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.
verses.strongsText: So then[G1161] they that are[G5607] in[G1722] the flesh[G4561] cannot[G3756] [G1410] please[G700] God[G2316].

verses.text: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] ye[G5210] are[G2075] not[G3756] in[G1722] the flesh[G4561], but[G235] in[G1722] the Spirit[G4151], if so be[G1512] that the Spirit[G4151] of God[G2316] dwell[G3611] in[G1722] you[G5213]. Now[G1161] if any man[G1536] have[G2192] not[G3756] the Spirit[G4151] of Christ[G5547], he[G3778] is[G2076] none[G3756] of his[G846].

verses.text: And if Christ *be* in you, the body *is* dead because of sin; but the Spirit *is* life because of righteousness.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] if[G1487] Christ[G5547] be in[G1722] you[G5213], the body[G4983] [G3303] is dead[G3498] because[G1223] of sin[G266]; but[G1161] the Spirit[G4151] is life[G2222] because[G1223] of righteousness[G1343].

verses.text: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] if[G1487] the Spirit[G4151] of him that raised up[G1453] Jesus[G2424] from[G1537] the dead[G3498] dwell[G3611] in[G1722] you[G5213], he that raised up[G1453] Christ[G5547] from[G1537] the dead[G3498] shall[G2227] also[G2532] quicken[G2227] your[G5216] mortal[G2349] bodies[G4983] by[G1223] his[G846] Spirit[G4151] that dwelleth[G1774] [G1774] in[G1722] you[G5213].

verses.text: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
verses.strongsText: Therefore[G686] [G3767], brethren[G80], we are[G2070] debtors[G3781], not[G3756] to the flesh[G4561], to live[G2198] after[G2596] the flesh[G4561].

verses.text: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] if[G1487] ye[G5210] live[G2198] after[G2596] the flesh[G4561], ye[G5210] shall[G3195] die[G599]: but[G1161] if[G1487] ye[G2289] through the Spirit[G4151] do mortify[G2289] the deeds[G4234] of the body[G4983], ye[G5210] shall live[G2198].

verses.text: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] as many as[G3745] are led[G71] by the Spirit[G4151] of God[G2316], they[G3778] are[G1526] the sons[G5207] of God[G2316].

verses.text: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] ye[G5210] have[G2983] not[G3756] received[G2983] the spirit[G4151] of bondage[G1397] again[G3825] to[G1519] fear[G5401]; but[G235] ye[G5210] have received[G2983] the Spirit[G4151] of adoption[G5206], whereby[G1722] [G3739] we cry[G2896], Abba[G5], Father[G3962].

verses.text: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
verses.strongsText: The Spirit[G4151] itself[G846] beareth witness[G4828] with our[G2257] spirit[G4151], that[G3754] we are[G2070] the children[G5043] of God[G2316]:

verses.strongsText: And[G1161] if[G1487] children[G5043], then[G2532] heirs[G2818]; heirs[G2818] of God[G3303] [G2316], and[G1161] joint-heirs[G4789] with Christ[G5547]; if so be[G1512] that we suffer with[G4841] him, that[G2443] we may be[G4888] also[G2532] glorified together[G4888].

verses.text: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time *are* not worthy *to be compared* with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] I reckon[G3049] that[G3754] the sufferings[G3804] of this present[G3568] time[G2540] are not[G3756] worthy[G514] to be compared with[G4314] the glory[G1391] which shall[G3195] be revealed[G601] in[G1519] us[G2248].

verses.text: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] the earnest expectation[G603] of the creature[G2937] waiteth[G553] for the manifestation[G602] of the sons[G5207] of God[G2316].

verses.text: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected *the same* in hope,
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] the creature[G2937] was made subject[G5293] to vanity[G3153], not[G3756] willingly[G1635], but[G235] by reason[G1223] of him who hath subjected[G5293] the same in[G1909] hope[G1680],

verses.text: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.
verses.strongsText: Because[G3754] the creature[G2937] itself[G846] also[G2532] shall be delivered[G1659] from[G575] the bondage[G1397] of corruption[G5356] into[G1519] the glorious[G1391] liberty[G1657] of the children[G5043] of God[G2316].

verses.text: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] we know[G1492] that[G3754] the whole[G3956] creation[G2937] groaneth[G4959] and[G2532] travaileth in pain together[G4944] until[G891] now[G3568].

verses.text: And not only *they*, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, *to wit*, the redemption of our body.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] not[G3756] only[G3440] they, but[G235] ourselves[G846] also[G2532], which have[G2192] the firstfruits[G536] of the Spirit[G4151], even[G2532] we[G2249] ourselves[G846] groan[G4727] within[G1722] ourselves[G1438], waiting[G553] for the adoption[G5206], to wit, the redemption[G629] of our[G2257] body[G4983].

verses.text: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] we are saved[G4982] by hope[G1680]: but[G1161] hope[G1680] that is seen[G991] is[G2076] not[G3756] hope[G1680]: for[G1063] what[G3739] a man[G5100] seeth[G991], why[G5101] doth he[G1679] yet[G2532] hope for[G1679]?

verses.strongsText: But[G1161] if[G1487] we hope[G1679] for that[G3739] we see[G991] not[G3756], then do we[G553] with[G1223] patience[G5281] wait for[G553] it.

verses.text: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
verses.strongsText: [G1161] Likewise[G5615] the Spirit[G4151] also[G2532] helpeth[G4878] our[G2257] infirmities[G769]: for[G1063] we know[G1492] not[G3756] what[G5101] we should pray for[G4336] as[G2526] we ought[G1163]: but[G235] the Spirit[G4151] itself[G846] maketh intercession[G5241] for[G5228] us[G2257] with groanings[G4726] which cannot be uttered[G215].

verses.text: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what *is* the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to *the will of* God.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] he that searcheth[G2045] the hearts[G2588] knoweth[G1492] what[G5101] is the mind[G5427] of the Spirit[G4151], because[G3754] he maketh intercession[G1793] for[G5228] the saints[G40] according[G2596] to the will of God[G2316].

verses.text: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to *his* purpose.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] we know[G1492] that all things[G3956] work together[G4903] for[G1519] good[G18] to them that[G3754] love[G25] God[G2316], to them who are[G5607] the called[G2822] according[G2596] to his purpose[G4286].

verses.text: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate *to be* conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.
verses.strongsText: For[G3754] whom[G3739] he did foreknow[G4267], he[G4309] also[G2532] did predestinate[G4309] to be conformed[G4832] to the image[G1504] of his[G846] Son[G5207], that[G1519] he[G846] might be[G1511] the firstborn[G4416] among[G1722] many[G4183] brethren[G80].

verses.text: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.
verses.strongsText: Moreover[G1161] whom[G3739] he did predestinate[G4309], them[G5128] he[G2564] also[G2532] called[G2564]: and[G2532] whom[G3739] he called[G2564], them[G5128] he[G1344] also[G2532] justified[G1344]: and[G1161] whom[G3739] he justified[G1344], them[G5128] he[G1392] also[G2532] glorified[G1392].

verses.text: What shall we then say to these things? If God *be* for us, who *can be* against us?
verses.strongsText: What[G5101] shall we[G2046] then[G3767] say[G2046] to[G4314] these things[G5023]? If[G1487] God[G2316] be for[G5228] us[G2257], who[G5101] can be against[G2596] us[G2257]?

verses.text: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
verses.strongsText: He that[G3739] [G1065] spared[G5339] not[G3756] his own[G2398] Son[G5207], but[G235] delivered[G3860] him[G846] up[G3860] for[G5228] us[G2257] all[G3956], how[G4459] shall he[G5483] not[G3780] with[G4862] him[G846] also[G2532] freely give[G5483] us[G2254] all things[G3956]?

verses.text: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? *It is* God that justifieth.
verses.strongsText: Who[G5101] shall lay any thing[G1458] to the charge[G2596] of God's[G2316] elect[G1588]? It is God[G2316] that justifieth[G1344].

verses.text: Who *is* he that condemneth? *It is* Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.
verses.strongsText: Who[G5101] is he that condemneth[G2632]? It is Christ[G5547] that died[G599], yea[G1161] rather[G3123] [G2532], that is risen again[G1453], who[G3739] is[G2076] even[G2532] at[G1722] the right hand[G1188] of God[G2316], who[G3739] also[G2532] maketh intercession[G1793] for[G5228] us[G2257].

verses.text: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? *shall* tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
verses.strongsText: Who[G5101] shall separate[G5563] us[G2248] from[G575] the love[G26] of Christ[G5547]? shall tribulation[G2347], or[G2228] distress[G4730], or[G2228] persecution[G1375], or[G2228] famine[G3042], or[G2228] nakedness[G1132], or[G2228] peril[G2794], or[G2228] sword[G3162]?

verses.text: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.strongsText: As[G2531] it is written[G1125],[G3754] For thy[G4675] sake[G1752] we are killed[G2289] all[G3650] the day long[G2250]; we are accounted[G3049] as[G5613] sheep[G4263] for the slaughter[G4967].

verses.text: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
verses.strongsText: Nay[G235], in[G1722] all[G3956] these things[G5125] we are more than conquerors[G5245] through[G1223] him that loved[G25] us[G2248].

verses.text: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] I am persuaded[G3982], that[G3754] neither[G3777] death[G2288], nor[G3777] life[G2222], nor[G3777] angels[G32], nor[G3777] principalities[G746], nor[G3777] powers[G1411], nor[G3777] things present[G1764], nor[G3777] things to come[G3195],

verses.strongsText: Nor[G3777] height[G5313], nor[G3777] depth[G899], nor[G3777] any[G5100] other[G2087] creature[G2937], shall be able[G1410] to separate[G5563] us[G2248] from[G575] the love[G26] of God[G2316], which is in[G1722] Christ[G5547] Jesus[G2424] our[G2257] Lord[G2962].

verses.text: For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God, it pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.

verses.text: For the Jews require a sign, and the Greeks seek after wisdom:

verses.text: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men; and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

verses.text: For ye see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, *are called*:

verses.text: And base things of the world, and things which are despised, hath God chosen, *yea*, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are:

verses.text: That no flesh should glory in his presence.

verses.text: And I, brethren, when I came to you, came not with excellency of speech or of wisdom, declaring unto you the testimony of God.

verses.text: And my speech and my preaching *was* not with enticing words of man's wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power:
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] my[G3450] speech[G3056] and[G2532] my[G3450] preaching[G2782] was not[G3756] with[G1722] enticing[G3981] words[G3056] of man's[G442] wisdom[G4678], but[G235] in[G1722] demonstration[G585] of the Spirit[G4151] and[G2532] of power[G1411]:

verses.text: Howbeit we speak wisdom among them that are perfect: yet not the wisdom of this world, nor of the princes of this world, that come to nought:

verses.strongsText: Which[G3739] none[G3762] of the princes[G758] of this[G5127] world[G165] knew[G1097]: for[G1487] [G1063] had they known[G1097] it, they[G302] would[G4717] not[G3756] have crucified[G4717] the Lord[G2962] of glory[G1391].

verses.text: But God hath revealed *them* unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of God.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] God[G2316] hath revealed[G601] them unto us[G2254] by[G1223] his[G846] Spirit[G4151]: for[G1063] the Spirit[G4151] searcheth[G2045] all things[G3956], yea[G2532], the deep things[G899] of God[G2316].

verses.text: But he that is spiritual judgeth all things, yet he himself is judged of no man.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] he that is spiritual[G4152] judgeth[G350] [G3303] all things[G3956], yet[G1161] he himself[G846] is judged[G350] of[G5259] no man[G3762].

verses.text: For ye are yet carnal: for whereas *there is* among you envying, and strife, and divisions, are ye not carnal, and walk as men?

verses.strongsText: Now[G1161] he that planteth[G5452] and[G2532] he that watereth[G4222] are[G1526] one[G1520]: and[G1161] every man[G1538] shall receive[G2983] his own[G2398] reward[G3408] according[G2596] to his own[G2398] labour[G2873].

But[G235] every man[G1538] hath[G2192] his proper[G2398] gift[G5486] of[G1537] God[G2316], one[G3739] [G3303] after this manner[G3779], and[G1161] another[G3739] after that[G3779].

verses.text: I say therefore to the unmarried and widows, It is good for them if they abide even as I.
verses.strongsText: I say[G3004] therefore[G1161] to the unmarried[G22] and[G2532] widows[G5503], It is[G2076] good[G2570] for them[G846] if[G1437] they abide[G3306] even[G2504] as[G5613] I[G2504].

verses.text: But if they cannot contain, let them marry: for it is better to marry than to burn.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] if[G1487] they[G1467] cannot[G3756] contain[G1467], let them marry[G1060]: for[G1063] it is[G2076] better[G2909] to marry[G1060] than[G2228] to burn[G4448].

verses.text: And unto the married I command, *yet* not I, but the Lord, Let not the wife depart from *her* husband:
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] unto the married[G1060] I command[G3853], yet not[G3756] I[G1473], but[G235] the Lord[G2962], Let[G5563] not[G3361] the wife[G1135] depart[G5563] from[G575] her husband[G435]:

verses.text: But and if she depart, let her remain unmarried, or be reconciled to *her* husband: and let not the husband put away *his* wife.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] and[G2532] if[G1437] she depart[G5563], let her remain[G3306] unmarried[G22], or[G2228] be reconciled[G2644] to her husband[G435]: and[G2532] let[G863] not[G3361] the husband[G435] put away[G863] his wife[G1135].

verses.text: But to the rest speak I, not the Lord: If any brother hath a wife that believeth not, and she be pleased to dwell with him, let him not put her away.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] to the rest[G3062] speak[G3004] I[G1473], not[G3756] the Lord[G2962]: If any[G1536] brother[G80] hath[G2192] a wife[G1135] that believeth not[G571], and[G2532] she[G846] be pleased[G4909] to dwell[G3611] with[G3326] him[G846], let him[G863] not[G3361] put[G863] her[G846] away[G863].

verses.text: And the woman which hath an husband that believeth not, and if he be pleased to dwell with her, let her not leave him.
verses.strongsText: And[G2532] the woman[G1135] which[G3748] hath[G2192] an husband[G435] that believeth not[G571], and[G2532] if he[G846] be pleased[G4909] to dwell[G3611] with[G3326] her[G846], let her[G863] not[G3361] leave[G863] him[G846].

verses.text: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified by the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified by the husband: else were your children unclean; but now are they holy.
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] the unbelieving[G571] husband[G435] is sanctified[G37] by[G1722] the wife[G1135], and[G2532] the unbelieving[G571] wife[G1135] is sanctified[G37] by[G1722] the husband[G435]: else[G686] [G1893] were[G2076] your[G5216] children[G5043] unclean[G169]; but[G1161] now[G3568] are they[G2076] holy[G40].

verses.text: But if the unbelieving depart, let him depart. A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such *cases*: but God hath called us to peace.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] if[G1487] the unbelieving[G571] depart[G5563], let him depart[G5563]. A brother[G80] or[G2228] a sister[G79] is[G1402] not[G3756] under bondage[G1402] in[G1722] such[G5108] cases: but[G1161] God[G2316] hath called[G2564] us[G2248] to[G1722] peace[G1515].

verses.text: For what knowest thou, O wife, whether thou shalt save *thy* husband? or how knowest thou, O man, whether thou shalt save *thy* wife?
verses.strongsText: For[G1063] what[G5101] knowest thou[G1492], O wife[G1135], whether[G1487] thou[G4771] shalt save[G4982] thy[G4675] husband[G435]? or[G2228] how[G5101] knowest thou[G1492], O man[G435], whether[G1487] thou[G4771] shalt save[G4982] thy[G4675] wife[G1135]?

verses.text: But as God hath distributed to every man, as the Lord hath called every one, so let him walk. And so ordain I in all churches.
verses.strongsText: But[G1508] as[G5613] God[G2316] hath distributed[G3307] to every man[G1538], as[G5613] the Lord[G2962] hath called[G2564] every one[G1538], so[G3779] let him walk[G4043]. And[G2532] so[G3779] ordain I[G1299] in[G1722] all[G3956] churches[G1577].

verses.text: Is any man called being circumcised? let him not become uncircumcised. Is any called in uncircumcision? let him not be circumcised.

verses.strongsText: Circumcision[G4061] is[G2076] nothing[G3762], and[G2532] uncircumcision[G203] is[G2076] nothing[G3762], but[G235] the keeping[G5084] of the commandments[G1785] of God[G2316].

verses.text: Let every man abide in the same calling wherein he was called.

verses.text: Art thou called *being* a servant? care not for it: but if thou mayest be made free, use *it* rather.

verses.strongsText: For[G1063] he that is called[G2564] in[G1722] the Lord[G2962], being a servant[G1401], is[G2076] the Lord's[G2962] freeman[G558]: likewise[G3668] also[G2532] he that is called[G2564], being free[G1658], is[G2076] Christ's[G5547] servant[G1401].

verses.text: Ye are bought with a price; be not ye the servants of men.
verses.strongsText: Ye[G5210] are bought[G59] with a price[G5092]; be[G1096] not[G3361] ye[G1096] the servants[G1401] of men[G444].

verses.text: Now concerning virgins I have no commandment of the Lord: yet I give my judgment, as one that hath obtained mercy of the Lord to be faithful.

verses.text: I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress, *I say*, that *it is* good for a man so to be.

verses.text: But and if thou marry, thou hast not sinned; and if a virgin marry, she hath not sinned. Nevertheless such shall have trouble in the flesh: but I spare you.

verses.text: But this I say, brethren, the time *is* short: it remaineth, that both they that have wives be as though they had none;

verses.text: But I would have you without carefulness. He that is unmarried careth for the things that belong to the Lord, how he may please the Lord:
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] I would have[G1511] [G2309] you[G5209] without carefulness[G275]. He that is unmarried[G22] careth[G3309] for the things that belong to[G3588] the Lord[G2962], how[G4459] he may please[G700] the Lord[G2962]:

verses.text: There is difference *also* between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman careth for the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit: but she that is married careth for the things of the world, how she may please *her* husband.

The unmarried woman[G22] careth for[G3309] the things[G3588] of the Lord[G2962], that[G2443] she may be[G5600] holy[G40] both[G2532] in body[G4983] and[G2532] in spirit[G4151]: but[G1161] she that is married[G1060] careth[G3309] for the things[G3588] of the world[G2889], how[G4459] she may please[G700] her husband[G435].

verses.text: And this I speak for your own profit; not that I may cast a snare upon you, but for that which is comely, and that ye may attend upon the Lord without distraction.
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] this[G5124] I speak[G3004] for[G4314] your[G5216] own[G846] profit[G4851]; not[G3756] that[G2443] I may cast[G1911] a snare[G1029] upon you[G5213], but[G235] for that which[G4314] is comely[G2158], and[G2532] that ye[G5210] may attend upon[G2145] the Lord[G2962] without distraction[G563].

verses.text: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of *her* age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sinneth not: let them marry.

verses.text: Nevertheless he that standeth stedfast in his heart, having no necessity, but hath power over his own will, and hath so decreed in his heart that he will keep his virgin, doeth well.
verses.strongsText: Nevertheless[G1161] he[G3739] that standeth[G2476] stedfast[G1476] in[G1722] his heart[G2588], having[G2192] no[G3361] necessity[G318], but[G1161] hath[G2192] power[G1849] over[G4012] his own[G2398] will[G2307], and[G2532] hath[G2919] so[G5124] decreed[G2919] in[G1722] his[G846] heart[G2588] that he will keep[G5083] his[G1438] virgin[G3933], doeth[G4160] well[G2573].

verses.strongsText: So[G5620] then[G2532] he that giveth her in marriage[G1547] doeth[G4160] well[G2573]; but[G1161] he that giveth her [G1547] not[G3361] in marriage[G1547] doeth[G4160] better[G2908].

verses.strongsText: The wife[G1135] is bound[G1210] by the law[G3551] [G1909] as long[G5550] as[G3745] her[G846] husband[G435] liveth[G2198]; but[G1161] if[G1437] her[G846] husband[G435] be dead[G2837], she is[G2076] at liberty[G1658] to be married[G1060] to whom[G3739] she will[G2309]; only[G3440] in[G1722] the Lord[G2962].

verses.text: But she is happier if she so abide, after my judgment: and I think also that I have the Spirit of God.
verses.strongsText: But[G1161] she is[G2076] happier[G3107] if[G1437] she[G3306] so[G3779] abide[G3306], after[G2596] my[G1699] judgment[G1106]: and[G1161] I think[G1380] also[G2504] that I have[G2192] the Spirit[G4151] of God[G2316].

verses.strongsText: Now[G1161] as touching[G4012] things offered unto idols[G1494], we know[G1492] that[G3754] we all[G3956] have[G2192] knowledge[G1108]. Knowledge[G1108] puffeth up[G5448], but[G1161] charity[G26] edifieth[G3618].

verses.text: As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols, we know that an idol *is* nothing in the world, and that *there is* none other God but one.
verses.strongsText: As concerning[G4012] therefore[G3767] the eating[G1035] of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols[G1494], we know[G1492] that[G3754] an idol[G1497] is nothing[G3762] in[G1722] the world[G2889], and[G2532] that[G3754] there is none[G3762] other[G2087] God[G2316] but[G1508] one[G1520].

verses.strongsText: Howbeit[G235] there is not[G3756] in[G1722] every man[G3956] that knowledge[G1108]: for[G1161] some[G5100] with conscience[G4893] of the idol[G1497] unto[G2193] this hour[G737] eat[G2068] it as[G5613] a thing offered unto an idol[G1494]; and[G2532] their[G846] conscience[G4893] being[G5607] weak[G772] is defiled[G3435].

verses.strongsText: But[G1161] when ye[G5210] sin[G264] so[G3779] against[G1519] the brethren[G80], and[G2532] wound[G5180] their[G846] weak[G770] conscience[G4893], ye[G5210] sin[G264] against[G1519] Christ[G5547].

verses.text: And though I bestow all my goods to feed *the poor*, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.

verses.text: Charity suffereth long, *and* is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,

verses.text: Charity never faileth: but whether *there be* prophecies, they shall fail; whether *there be* tongues, they shall cease; whether *there be* knowledge, it shall vanish away.

verses.text: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.

verses.text: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.

verses.text: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?

verses.strongsText: Do we begin[G756] again[G3825] to commend[G4921] ourselves[G1438]? or[G1508] need we[G5535], as[G5613] some[G5100] others, epistles[G1992] of commendation[G4956] to[G4314] you[G5209], or[G2228] letters of commendation[G4956] from[G1537] you[G5216]?

verses.text: Ye are our epistle written in our hearts, known and read of all men:
verses.strongsText: Ye[G5210] are[G2075] our[G2257] epistle[G1992] written[G1449] in[G1722] our[G2257] hearts[G2588], known[G1097] and[G2532] read[G314] of[G5259] all[G3956] men[G444]:

verses.text: *Forasmuch as ye are* manifestly declared to be the epistle of Christ ministered by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tables of stone, but in fleshy tables of the heart.
verses.strongsText: Forasmuch as ye[G5210] are manifestly declared[G5319] to[G3754] be[G2075] the epistle[G1992] of Christ[G5547] ministered[G1247] by[G5259] us[G2257], written[G1449] not[G3756] with ink[G3188], but[G235] with the Spirit[G4151] of the living[G2198] God[G2316]; not[G3756] in[G1722] tables[G4109] of stone[G3035], but[G235] in[G1722] fleshy[G4560] tables[G4109] of the heart[G2588].

verses.text: And such trust have we through Christ to God-ward:
verses.strongsText: And[G1161] such[G5108] trust[G4006] have we[G2192] through[G1223] Christ[G5547] to[G4314] God-ward[G2316]:
